name: Evil Engine
description: Our own 2D game engine SDK in C# on OpenGL 3.3 (Evil.Engine + Evil.Engine.Mathematics), grown from MyGameFrameWork; the base for the turn-based game.

prod.notes: Packages go to the folder feed /mnt/hdd/projects/MyGameFrameWork-data/feed; games pin the exact version.

dev.notes: Opens a desktop window, no port. On the server run scripts/check.sh instead (xvfb).

check.notes: Build with warnings as errors, the test runner, a still frame and a frame driven with real keys and mouse (xvfb, xdotool); screenshots in documents/screenshots.

flow.promote: scripts/check.sh green, bump the version in Directory.Build.props, commit, ./scripts/pack.sh, push; games move to the exact version.
rules: Lock-step versions: both packages carry the same version.
Packages only from the checked list, exact versions in Directory.Packages.props.
The engine reads no config and no environment variable: games pass values to GameBuilder.
